name: GMGN
description: Discover faster, Trading in seconds http://gmgn.ai

methodology.Fees: All trading fees paid by users while using GMGN AI bot (1% per trade), collected in both the native gas token and USDC, tracked via Dune. Solana = native-SOL + USDC inflows to the fee wallets; EVM = native gas-token + USDC inflows to the fee collector.
methodology.Revenue: Trading fees retained by GMGN after referral commissions. Solana referral is measured on-chain; EVM referral is estimated at the measured Solana referral rate (~16% of fees).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Referral commissions GMGN pays to referrers. Solana = measured outflows (SOL + USDC/USDT/USD1) from its three referral-distribution wallets; EVM = estimated at the Solana referral rate since EVM fees off-ramp to a CEX and referral can't be isolated on-chain.

Fees.Trading Fees: Fees paid by users while using GMGN bot.

Revenue.Trading Fees: Trading fees retained by GMGN after referral payouts.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees: Trading fees retained by GMGN after referral payouts.

SupplySideRevenue.Referral rewards: Referral commissions measured as outflows from GMGN's Solana referral wallets.
SupplySideRevenue.Referral rewards (estimated): EVM referral commissions, estimated at the measured Solana referral rate (EVM payouts off-ramp to a CEX and can't be isolated on-chain).
